title: openai-compat: tool_choice semantics, schema mapping, and tool message formatting
description: Adds OpenAI-compatibility improvements for function/tool calling: stable tool_choice semantics, deterministic mapping from OpenAI-style tool schemas to Redwood tool registry schemas, and standardized tool-call message formatting (including provenance and structured payloads). This PR also updates streaming to emit explicit tool_choice events for compatibility with OpenAI streaming clients and fixes several edge cases where partial stream tokens caused malformed tool-call JSON. Motivation: customers using the OpenAI-compatible API expect consistent tool selection behaviour (tool_choice) and predictable tool call payloads across streamed and non-streamed responses. Changes include a new schema mapper, enhanced tool_call message formatting, streaming token stabilization for tool events, compatibility tests, and docs updates. NOTE: description contains an implementation checklist: [x] schema mapper implementation [x] tool_choice event in streaming [x] message formatting conventions and provenance fields [x] unit and integration tests [x] docs & examples updated.

review_comments: Arjun: Could you clarify how we decide between multiple matching tools when the OpenAI schema lacks a unique id? Suggest adding deterministic tie-breaker (name + arg signature).

Lena: Streaming change looks good but CI showed intermittent JSON parsing errors when the model emitted partial tool_call fragments. Can we add buffering until a complete tool_choice event is observed?

Author: Streaming runtime now emits explicit 'tool_choice' event frames and buffers partial tokens for tool_call blocks until JSON is complete or a short timeout elapses. This prevents malformed message events and keeps latency impact minimal.
Diego: We need to ensure tool provenance appears in the tool_call message (which tool mapping matched, transform applied). Add provenance fields.
Author: Added 'redwood_tool_match' metadata to tool_call messages: mapped_tool_id, mapping_rule, and schema_version. Console templates updated to render provenance for debugging.
Arjun: Minor nit: add an integration test that exercises fallback when schema mapping fails (should return a benign error and not crash the runtime).
Author: Added test_openai_tool_choice.py to cover mapping failures, unknown tools, and streaming partials. Tests included in CI matrix.
Lena: Approved after CI green. Diego: Approved. Arjun: Approved.
release_notes: Add OpenAI-compatible tool_choice handling and schema mapping; stabilize streaming tool events to avoid malformed tool_call payloads; include provenance fields in tool_call messages; update SDK and docs with examples and migration guidance.
body_summary: This PR standardizes OpenAI-compatible tool calling by mapping OpenAI tool schemas to Redwood tool definitions, implementing deterministic tool_choice selection semantics, stabilizing streaming to emit explicit tool_choice events, and formatting tool_call messages with provenance and validated JSON payloads. Includes tests and docs.
diff_snippets:
--- a/redwood/openai_compat/schema_mapper.py
+++ b/redwood/openai_compat/schema_mapper.py
@@ -1,6 +1,34 @@
+# heuristic mapping: normalized_name -> arg_signature_hash -> created_at
+def map_openai_tool_schema(openai_schema, registry):
+    name = normalize(openai_schema['name'])
+    signature = extract_arg_signature(openai_schema.get('parameters', {}))
+    candidates = registry.find_by_name(name)
+    # deterministic tie-breaker: signature, then created_at
+    return select_best_candidate(candidates, signature)
--- a/redwood/runtime/streaming.py
+++ b/redwood/runtime/streaming.py
@@ -40,6 +40,18 @@
+                if event.type == 'tool_choice_fragment':
+                    buffer.append(event.text)
+                    if looks_like_complete_json(buffer):
+                        emit(Event('tool_choice', json_loads_safe(buffer)))
+                        buffer.clear()
+                    else:
+                        # wait up to 100ms for completion then fallback to parsing attempt
+                        schedule_timeout(0.1, try_flush_buffer)
--- a/redwood/openai_compat/handler.py
+++ b/redwood/openai_compat/handler.py
@@ -120,6 +120,16 @@
+    mapped = schema_mapper.map_openai_tool_schema(tool_schema, registry)
+    if not mapped:
+        return error_response('tool_mapping_failed', detail='No matching tool')
+    tool_call = format_tool_call(mapped, args)
+    # include provenance metadata for debugging and audit
+    tool_call['redwood_tool_match'] = { 'mapped_tool_id': mapped.id, 'mapping_rule': mapped.rule_id }
